verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms cubic serves a live llms.txt at docs.cubic.dev that indexes its documentation for agents. The docs are also published as markdown mirrors, and the API reference's markdown pages embed full OpenAPI YAML, which gives agents machine-readable docs. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or explicit agent-oriented docs guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Each Members API endpoint page's markdown mirror embeds the full OpenAPI 3.1.0 YAML for that operation
cubic publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for its Analytics API
